outcome: The escalation line workspace shows the live escalation and lets the PMO Lead decide, review and recover it
acceptance_criteria: `/work/4122` (mock) shows "Decide · PMO Lead", a note field and exactly the buttons "Escalate to the client", "Don't escalate" and "Return for rework"; `/work/4129` (`client_decisions:[]`) shows none of them — verify: `frontend/e2e/work-item-escalation.spec.ts` asserts the buttons by name on both.

Pressing "Escalate to the client" sends one `POST /api/v1/work/4122/escalation` with `{action:"decide_client_action", expected_revision, case_revision, request_id (= read id), role:"PMO Lead", verdict:"approve", note:"", delegated:false}`; "Don't escalate" sends `verdict:"reject"` and "Return for rework" sends `verdict:"return"` — verify: unit test on the descriptor bodies and e2e request assertion; no `approve` is ever sent by "Don't escalate".

"Don't escalate" and "Return for rework" with an empty or blank note send nothing and show "Add a note to return or refuse" next to the field — verify: e2e asserts zero POSTs; unit test on the validator.
A verdict not listed for the role (for example a read with only `["approve"]`) draws no button for the others — verify: unit test on `sections`/`Panel` with that read.

`/work/4123` shows "PMO Lead decided not to escalate on {date}" and the note in quotes, and no "Escalate"/"Don't escalate" buttons; with `note:null` no quote or placeholder is drawn; `/work/4124` reads "returned this for rework" and never "not to escalate" — verify: e2e on both and unit test on null note.
The verdict words come only from the verdict: `reject` is never shown as "returned" and `return` is never shown as "declined" — verify: unit test over all three verdicts in `history`.

`/work/4125` shows "Message v1" with each section's heading and text exactly as in the read, the recipients as given, and a "Send for review" button; pressing it sends `{action:"request_communication_review", expected_revision, case_revision, version_id}` with `version_id` equal to `document_version_id`; with `document_version_id:null` the button is disabled and nothing is sent — verify: e2e and unit test.
`/work/4130` (`recipients:null`) shows "Recipients not available to you." and no invented recipient — verify: e2e.

`/work/4126` shows the same message under "Approve and send" and "Return with a note"; "Approve and send" posts `/work/4126/reviews` `{kind:"document", expected_revision, case_revision, version_id, verdict:"approve", note:""}`; "Return with a note" with a blank note sends nothing, with a note posts `verdict:"return"` — verify: e2e request assertions; the page does not say "sent" after the approve, only the re-read state and receipts.
A `review_verdicts` of `["reject"]` draws no review button and the message stays readable — verify: unit test.

`/work/4127` shows "Delivery recorded {time}" once per `receipts[]` row and the board sentence that it doesn't resolve the issue; an item with `receipts:[]` shows no "Delivery recorded", "Delivered" or "verified" text anywhere in the panel, whatever `jobs[]` or `state` say — verify: e2e on 4127 and 4126; unit test with jobs present and no receipts.
"Verified" appears in the panel only when the work item's state is `verified`; it is not derived from `receipts[]` alone — verify: unit test with receipts and state `processing`.

`/work/4128` shows the job with "Retry" and "Cancel" and a required reason; "Check original delivery" is drawn because the state is `effect_uncertain`; Retry with a blank reason sends nothing; Cancel asks yes/no first; each posts `{action:"recover_delivery", expected_revision, case_revision, job_id, operation, reason}` — verify: e2e request assertions. A job whose `operations` is `[]` shows no button.

"Check original delivery" posts `{action:"check_original_delivery", expected_revision, case_revision}`, is not locked after an uncertain failure, and is not drawn when the state is not `awaiting_reconciliation` or `effect_uncertain` — verify: e2e and unit tests.

After any 200 the page re-reads the item and this panel and shows the re-read state; a double click makes one request — verify: e2e counts requests; `useWorkCommand` is imported, not copied (`grep -n "liveApi.POST" frontend/src/features/work-item frontend/src/features/workspace` shows no new POST outside `useWorkCommand`).

`/work/4131` (409 on writes) re-reads, shows "This changed while you were working. Showing the latest version." with the server message, keeps the typed note, and does not resend; `/work/4132` (403) shows "You can't do this." with the server message and the other controls follow the re-read — verify: e2e on both.

A network failure or 5xx on a decision or review press shows "We couldn't confirm that this happened. Check the page before trying again.", locks that button until the re-read shows a new revision, and sends nothing by itself — verify: unit test with fake timers (no timer sends) and e2e.

A 404 on the panel read gives "This record is unavailable." (same as the page); a 500 shows "We couldn't load this part of the page." with Try again and the rest of the page loads — verify: mock scenarios and e2e.

A read with a `direction`, `target` or `stage` value the page has no words for shows it raw and does not break; "Asked for" reads "Escalate to the client" for `escalate`/`Client` and no PMO/CTO/de-escalate wording is shown when the read says otherwise (the read's values are shown) — verify: unit test.

Nothing is drawn for Tola's findings (days late, milestone, times asked), investigation steps, "raised by" or an issue reference, and no placeholder stands in for them — verify: e2e asserts those strings are absent on 4121 to 4127.

No approver, role or authority is named by the UI except the `role` strings and history roles the read serves; no client-side role check hides or shows a control apart from the read's lists — verify: grep `escalationAdapter.ts` and `EscalationPanel.tsx` for the literals "PMO Lead", "Head of PMO", "CEO", "CTO" (none outside tests and the verdict-to-role type) and review the diff.
A page load, a poll and navigation make no POST; the only POSTs come from presses — verify: e2e asserts zero POSTs on load of each fixture.

Against live Django (8020, Postgres 55433), for a real escalation work item the panel shows the same direction, target, history, message and receipts as `GET /api/v1/work/{id}/escalation`, and the panel is found under the key the live `panels[]` gives — verify: compare the page with `oa.py live GET /api/v1/work/{id}/escalation` output; if the key differs from `escalation`, register the live key and record it in the PR.

Unit tests cover: `sections` for each board row above, `commands` bodies, the note and reason validators, the verdict-to-word mapping and the "no receipt, no delivered" rule — verify: `npm test` lists them.

Viewport check at 1440 and 390: each of the six boards matches its SCR-51 desktop and mobile artboard for the parts drawn, and no part leaves an empty heading or gap — verify: screenshots at both widths reviewed against `design/screens.md` SCR-51 artboards.
`npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass; `weeklyReportAdapter` tests still pass unchanged — verify: `delivery/checks.sh`.

risk.rationale: High because the line records a client-escalation decision and sends a message outside the company. Misreading reject as return, or treating a job claim as a delivered receipt, would misstate a business record (connect map SCR-51, D-31, D-32). Surfaces are ui, api and contract-change for the new reads and commands, auth for the server-gated decisions, external-messaging for the send and receipts, and product-decision because the flow is new to the client. Product acceptance is required.

completion.reason: Project, readiness, implementation and review evidence has not been supplied.
